d:
Watch this Bollywood Superhit Romantic Song Kasam Ki Kasam sung by Chitra and Shaan from Rajshri Production's Main Prem ki Diwani Hoon (2003) starring Kareena Kapoor, Hrithik Roshan, Abhishek Bachchan and directed by Sooraj Barjatya.
The song showcases a girl shyly professing her love for her beloved, in front of her family without interacting with him directly. Music composed by - Anu Malik.
